findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U7
findings.description: U7 (LTV-817S-TA1) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U7 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U7 with short, wide traces to vias.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (FIELD_DRY_CONTACTS) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J1

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (190×130mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 376 MHz; (0,1) at 550 MHz; (1,1) at 666 MHz; (2,0) at 752 MHz; (2,1) at 932 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Incomplete ground pour at board edges
findings.description: Ground pour covers ~60% of the board perimeter (53/132 sample points lack nearby ground zone). A continuous ground guard ring around the board perimeter reduces edge radiation. (Note: uses bounding box approximation.)
findings.recommendation: Add ground pour on outer layers extending to within 2mm of all board edges, connected by stitching vias.
findings.summary: Incomplete ground pour at board edges

findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
